NullMotion.title: Null Motion
NullMotion.blurb: Plays a finished motion-graphics ad in sync with the rough HyperFrames drafts it grew from, so the work between them is visible. Exports the breakdown as one MP4.

MotionClone.title: MotionClone
MotionClone.blurb: Point it at a reference video and it rebuilds the piece as an editable HyperFrames project, then plays the rebuild against the original so you can see where the timing drifts.

easyedit.title: easyedit
easyedit.blurb: Type a movie name, get a fan edit: the film's best speech in animated captions, then a montage cut to the beat. Whisper for transcription, onset detection for the cuts.

html-anime.title: html-anime
html-anime.blurb: Turns a scene prompt into a shot sheet, then has a coding agent draw the film in HTML and CSS. No video model — the frame above is code.

blixtrade.title: blixtrade
blixtrade.blurb: Solana memecoin terminal: live pump.fun feed, holder ledgers that separate snipers from bundles, real Jupiter quotes. Ships a public read API and an MCP server.

phonectl.title: phonectl
phonectl.blurb: Drives an Android phone from your computer over adb and scrcpy: browser dashboard, CLI, and a build → screenshot → verify loop for agents.

skills.title: skills
skills.blurb: The agent skills I use daily, as drop-in SKILL.md folders for Claude Code and Codex.

x-media.title: X Media
x-media.blurb: Browse public X media and tweets by username in a local Next.js app. No login, no API key.

ai-broadcaster.title: AI Broadcaster
ai-broadcaster.blurb: Chrome extension that sends one prompt, image, or PDF to several AI chats at once and verifies each one received it.
